SK6003 An abstract type has a public constructor

Nothing outside the type hierarchy can call it, so public on it states something that is not true.

CategoryDesign
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixyes, safe
Language version floor—
Since1.0
SupersedesCA1012

Why

An abstract class cannot be instantiated, so its constructor is reachable only from a derived constructor's initializer — which is exactly what protected allows. Written public, the modifier claims a caller that cannot exist, and a reader scanning the type for its public surface has to work out that this member is not part of it. protected says what the constructor is for. The edit is one keyword, it removes nothing any caller could have been using, and it is verified by the compiler.

Example

Instead of:

public abstract class Importer {
    public Importer(string name) {
        Name = name;
    }

    public string Name { get; }
}

Write:

public abstract class Importer {
    protected Importer(string name) {
        Name = name;
    }

    public string Name { get; }
}

When it does not fire

The rule is purely syntactic and fires only on a constructor declared exactly public inside a class declaration that carries the abstract modifier in the same file. A protected internal, internal or private protected constructor is left alone, because each of those is a deliberate statement about a different audience. A static constructor has no accessibility to change. Records are not reported at all: a positional record's primary constructor is a parameter list with no ConstructorDeclarationSyntax to edit, and a record's copy constructor has accessibility rules of its own that the compiler enforces (CS8878), so the one-keyword edit is not obviously legal there. A partial class whose abstract modifier sits on a different part is a miss rather than a wrong answer — the rule needs to see the modifier beside the constructor. A constructor whose public token carries a preprocessor directive in its trivia is skipped, because the token the fix replaces may not exist in every branch.
